1.bug_scenario: The bug involves incorrect size information being displayed in the Critical Request Chain section of Lighthouse. All resources are shown with the same size, which does not match their actual sizes. This issue is present in both the built-in Lighthouse in Chrome Canary and the Chrome Extension of Lighthouse. The images show a list of resources with their sizes and the Critical Request Chains view, where all resources are incorrectly listed as having the same size of 38.18KB.
